visual_anatomy.title: A large plain-language question is paired with one oversized quoted, rough-display phrase inside a lavender rounded rectangle.
visual_anatomy.layout: A 2×2 coloured matrix fills most of the page. Cross-axis labels sit on the centre lines; each quadrant contains a short interpretation plus eight fill-in-the-blank prompt pills.
visual_anatomy.reading_order: Headline and one-line setup → the two directional axes → quadrant identity and interpretation → scan the prompt pills inside the relevant quadrant.
visual_anatomy.typography: Light, oversized sans for the sentence-level title; a contrasting rough-display treatment for the highlighted phrase; bold dark quadrant labels and compact sans prompts.
visual_anatomy.colour: Lavender, pink, aqua, and pale blue distinguish the four cells while black type and dark outlines preserve the shared matrix structure.
visual_anatomy.surface: White outer margin; tinted flat cells; thin dark rules; rounded prompt tokens with darker outlines and soft offset shadows.
visual_anatomy.modules: One matrix, four quadrant labels, four interpretive statements, and thirty-two repeated editable prompt starters.
visual_anatomy.density: Very high, but the repeated pill unit and quadrant membership make it browseable as an idea bank rather than a paragraph.

transferable_mechanism.reader_job: Find a useful starting point inside a large option set without losing the distinction between the options.
transferable_mechanism.argument_shape: Two-variable decision matrix with a reusable prompt library inside each cell.
transferable_mechanism.mechanism: Make two genuine dimensions visible first, then give every resulting cell its own reader-facing meaning and a set of consistently formatted candidate moves.
transferable_mechanism.use_condition: Use only when two variables create meaningfully different actions and the cell-level examples are genuinely interchangeable starters, not a dressed-up unordered list.

anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the build-in-public subject, quoted headline cadence, four named quadrants, fill-in-the-blank wording, pastel cell sequence, central axis labels, rough-display tag, or pill geometry.

claim_boundary.note: The source presents a conceptual prompt framework. A workbook caption exists only through a numeric-ID assertion, and no outcome implied by the framework is independently verified.
